tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (cool paper). Hover fill for quiet controls.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, sidebar, modal, toast, inputs, empty answer bubbles.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Blue-black ink. Body text and headings on bg, surface and every *-soft tint.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, placeholders, quiet icon buttons. On bg and surface.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: card edges, dividers, table rules. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control edges (inputs, secondary buttons, empty bubbles, meter tracks). Meets 3:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Print rules: the fine pink lines of the answer sheet (sheet header, gutter, form-section titles). Decorative only, never a control edge or text.

tokens.name: explain-bg
tokens.usage: The explanation panel after an answer. text, muted, accent and success all keep 4.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Answer-sheet pink. Primary fills, links, selected bubbles, meter fill and the focus ring. As text on bg, surface and accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected and tinted backgrounds: active nav item, selected option, tags, the active verdict filter. Text on it is accent or text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on accent, success and danger fills (dark in the dark theme, where those fills are light).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Correct outcome: the answer key, correct bubbles. Always paired with a mark or word (✓, Certo). Text on surface and success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a correct option or bubble. Replaces color-mix(success 14–25%, surface).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Wrong outcome, errors, destructive buttons, disputed badges. Always paired with a mark or word (✗, Errado). Text on surface and danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a wrong option or bubble. Replaces color-mix(danger 12–25%, surface).

tokens.name: flag
tokens.usage: Flagged-for-later: the flag button when pressed and the flag mark on a bubble. Text on surface. Also used for the non-text flag bar (merges the old flag-bar).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 3px solid, 2px offset, on everything keyboard-reachable.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Modal backdrop.

families.ui: "Instrument Sans Variable", "Instrument Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
families.reading: "Source Serif 4 Variable", "Source Serif 4", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Stat values, score recap, verdict counts (2rem).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Printed-form labels: uppercase, tracked. Sheet header, form-section titles, panel section titles, navigator group labels (0.75rem). Colour muted, or accent on the sheet header.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: All interface text (1rem). Weight 600 for emphasis and button labels.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Meta lines, hints, stat names, tooltips (0.875rem).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badges, counts, version (0.8rem). Tabular numerals for numbers.

styles.name: reading-lg
styles.sample: Julgue o item a seguir, relativo ao direito administrativo.
styles.usage: Question stems and options (1.125rem). Lines capped at measure (65ch).

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: A anulação decorre de ilegalidade e opera efeitos ex tunc.
styles.usage: Explanations and flagged-question previews in Revisar pacote (1rem).

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code, code blocks and keyboard keys in rich text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: 4px. Icon gaps, tight padding inside badges and tooltips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: 8px. Gap between buttons and options; control vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: 12px. Option and nav-item horizontal padding; stat-card gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: 16px. Button horizontal padding; modal header padding; section gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: 20px. Card vertical padding; modal body inset.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: 24px. Card horizontal padding; gap between cards and page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: 32px. Page top padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: 40px. Page side padding on wide windows.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small chrome: tooltips, the sidebar toggle, kbd keys.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Everything rectangular: buttons, inputs, cards, options, modal, toast.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Answer bubbles, navigator bubbles, badges, counts, meter tracks.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Toasts and tooltips: things that float near content.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Modals only. Cards are flat: border, no shadow.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max line length for reading text (reading-lg and reading).

tokens.name: content-width
tokens.usage: Default card max width.

tokens.name: content-width-wide
tokens.usage: Wide cards: performance tables, stat grids, Início.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Sidebar with labels.

tokens.name: sidebar-width-collapsed
tokens.usage: Icon-only sidebar (by choice, or always below 60rem).

tokens.name: bubble-size
tokens.usage: Answer bubble on an option. Navigator bubbles use 2.5rem (bubble-size-lg).

tokens.name: bubble-size-lg
tokens.usage: Navigator bubbles: big enough to click, holds a two-digit number.

tokens.name: sheet-width
tokens.usage: The question sheet column in Resolver, centred in the content area.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: The navigator rail beside the sheet: five bubble-size-lg columns with gaps.

tokens.name: gutter-width
tokens.usage: The numbered gutter left of the stem on the sheet.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and selection colour changes. Easing: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1).

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: The bubble pop on a confirmed correct answer and the meter fill. Nothing moves under prefers-reduced-motion.
